characters.name: thor
characters.description: Thor — the singer/narrator. Adult man, contemplative gaze, present and grounded. Aesthetic: wintry/poetic/noir palette (cool silvers, deep blues, candlelight warmth). Mood: introspective, listening to bells in the frozen night.

shots.description: Thor in profile against a near-black backdrop, looking upward — as if listening for bells he cannot quite see. Subtle motion only: a faint breath, the smallest tilt of the head, light shifting on his face. Cinematic, painterly, Poe-esque. Maintain the photographic stillness; this is portrait-with-pulse, not action.
